title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) – our proposal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

thank you for your offer and for the partnership you showed in 2022.

Our should-cost estimate for part:310010 is EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010), below your price. The forecast for part:310010 increased by 10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price. PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96%.

We attach three packages. You asked about faster payment (doc:20260902-70110-M2), so one package shortens our payment terms to ease your cash flow. The others keep your standard payment terms. The later effective dates give both sides planning time. Which package suits you best? Are there cheaper casting variants we should consider?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings (part:310010) – our proposal
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the volume change data and should cost data you cited; both hold and we took them into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

However, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Still, a binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

We appreciate your detailed response and the inclusion of a 14-day payment term in your second package, which reflects our long-standing partnership. Regarding your question about cheaper casting variants, our technical team can review the specifications, though our current process is necessary to maintain the high quality you rely on.

Our current Angebot is a price of €136.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Foundry Engineer: We build strictly according to your drawing and do not propose any design changes.

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings – volume commitment and revised package
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

thank you for taking our data into account and for moving towards us.

On volume: the attached package commits us to 8150 pieces per year over a 12-month contract. That gives you a firm base load to plan your foundry capacity.

Your latest scorecard records on-time delivery of 85.2% (sc:70110@2026Q3). A stable price lets us keep our call-offs steady, which should help both of us improve delivery reliability.

We keep your preferred structure: 14-day payment for your cash flow and the later effective date. Could you make this your standing offer? What is the earliest lead time you could confirm on these terms?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings – volume commitment and revised package
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As to the delivery record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We have verified the delivery record you cited and value your firm commitment to 8150 pieces over a 12-month contract. 

In recognition of this base load and to support steady call-offs, we offer a revised price of €132.80 per unit. Regarding your question, our production team confirms that standard lead times will apply under this contract. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days, and our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. 

Our complete Angebot stands at a price of €132.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings - revised package
messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

thank you for the revised offer and for confirming the 42-day lead time.

Your previous scorecard records 626 ppm (sc:70110@2026Q2).

We would like to keep quality at that level together. A stable price and steady monthly call-offs, as in your delivery schedule, give your team the planning calm to support this.

The attached package keeps your preferred structure: 8150 pieces per year over 12 months, 14-day payment for your cash flow, and the effective date of 1 April 2027. We have moved towards you on price. Could you make this package your standing offer?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: HN 50-200 volute casings - revised package

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. We have reviewed your email, but we have already taken our quality records into account in our previous offer. 

Our price of €132.80 is firm and represents our best offer for the 14-day payment term and 1 April 2027 effective date. We ask you to accept this offer so we can proceed with planning the production for your 8150 pieces. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

For your reference, our current Angebot stands at a price of €132.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

It is always a pleasure working with your team, and we look forward to continuing our long-standing cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

messages.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

thank you for your revised offer and for the 8D report. We value our long partnership, including your support in 2022 when you kept supplying at the old price for a quarter.

We have moved towards you again on price in the attached package. It keeps your preferred structure:
- 8150 pieces per year over a 12-month contract
- 14-day payment, which supports your cash flow
- an effective date of 1 April 2027

This gives your foundry a steady monthly base load while the corrective actions take effect. We hope we can close this together now.

Could you make this package your standing offer?

Kind regards,

messages.subject: Re: Volute casing HN 50-200 (part:310010) - revised package
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to deal with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, given our shared history and long-standing partnership over the years. We take immense pride in the work of our foundry and the quality we consistently deliver to your operations.

Regarding our current transaction, this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. However, our price of €132.60 is already our best offer for the 14-day payment term and 1 April 2027 effective date. To be completely precise, our proposal rests at a price of €132.60 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 14 days net, and is valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

We ask you to accept this offer so we can finalize the agreement and secure your base load. 

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
